title: Jack of All Trades trait evidence and controlled observation

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 1802982 (0x001b82e6), HLP file offset 454875 (0x0006f0db), topic 267 'Jack of All Trades'
provenance.note: Decoded help topic for Jack of All Trades; documented-only claim, not a runtime observation.

provenance.location: dialog #149 resource at file offset 0x2fa900, control 280, caption 'Jack of All Trades'; style 0x50000009 (BS_AUTORADIOBUTTON)
provenance.note: Executable location of the trait name/control is a lead; it does not prove runtime mechanics.

setup.baseline: A custom race with no other selected trait and otherwise identical wizard choices.
setup.variable: Select only Jack of All Trades and record the advantage-point balance and observable effects.
setup.universe: Single-player, fixed small universe with one Turindrones opponent if the runtime exposes it (otherwise record the actual opponent), fixed difficulty, no random events; keep the same seed/settings across trials.

procedure: Create the baseline race and record the step 1-6 settings and advantage-point balance.
Create the same race with only Jack of All Trades changed; record the exact advantage-point balance and any disabled controls.
Start the game and record starting technology, planets, fleets, installations and available catalog entries.
Run a controlled comparison for each documented effect, varying one input at a time and repeating at least three trials where randomness may apply.
Record the observed result, game year, settings and any discrepancy from the documented claim.

documented: Starts with tech 3 in all fields, two scouts, one colony ship, one medium freighter, one mini miner and one destroyer (documented-only).
Scout, Frigate and Destroyer hulls get a built-in scanner with range 2N / N light years, where N is 10 times Electronics tech (documented-only).
Improves all 'Costs 75% extra' fields to tech 4 when the step 6 box is checked (documented-only).

unresolved: Built-in scanner range rounding and its interaction with No Advanced Scanners are unknown.
The step 6 interaction and flat-fee behavior need runtime confirmation.
notes: The help is dated January 1998 and its applicability to stars26i.exe is unverified. No original-game execution is claimed by PR2.
